content: Quick-add pattern (YNAB): dedicated Add Transaction entry points on home/dashboard and inside list views (button, widget, shortcut) rather than requiring navigation to a separate page; last-used or predicted category/payee is suggested to speed entry. Mint used a simpler single 'Add a Transaction' button on the transactions page. Table stakes takeaway: quick-add should be reachable in 1 tap/click from both dashboard and list page.
